request.deadline: contract year through 2026-2027; architecture assessment by Q3 2027
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including node upgrades, wallet backend updates, hard fork readiness, platform support, release engineering, security and dependency maintenance, and signed releases
Ecosystem expansion including Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, CIP-30 dApp connector, user-facing CIP implementations, and Japanese localisation
User support across GitHub, community forums, direct channels, and Japanese-language support
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc. via Intersect administration and milestone-based disbursement controls
request.what: Daedalus Wallet Maintenance and Improvements 2026-2027 delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is described as Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet, deriving wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
The proposal states Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, with the true count claimed to be meaningfully higher.

Se7en Labs says it assumed Daedalus responsibility under an IOG contract in January 2026 and shipped Mithril Snapshot Bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend work, Apple Silicon builds, a release CLI, and Nix build modernization.
The proposal commits to a compatible Daedalus release at least two weeks before every mainnet hard fork during the contract period.
The requested budget totals 1,785,333 ADA, including 1,666,667 ADA for labor, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and a 52,000 ADA Intersect administration fee.
The proposal states any unspent labor, hardware, or audit budget will be returned to the treasury.
The proposal says release-timing and version-currency metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.
The proposal states Intersect will administer funds, independently verify milestones, hold funds in a dedicated auditable account, and disburse monthly against verified work.
The proposal asserts the withdrawal does not exceed the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.
The proposal states Se7en Labs has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The proposal requests 1,785,333 ADA for a time-and-materials public-good engagement to maintain and improve Daedalus through protocol upgrades, hard fork readiness, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, Japanese localisation, support, and an architecture assessment, with Intersect administration and milestone-based disbursement.
